description: Expose secret via shell command without no_log — T5 deny

playbook.content:
- name: Set API secret in env
  hosts: production
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: 'export SECRET={{ api_secret }}'

tier_rationale: Shell command exposes api_secret via command args (logged by default)
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: may not flag export in command
